The capital was built to last! Go
on! Get inside, where it's safe!

rows.label: tlk44310186_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Ah! Prince Sivrit and his retinue!
I didn't mean to offend.

rows.label: tlk44310186_03_msg0003
rows.name:
We've been ordered to evacuate people
from the outskirts and travelers into
the city. It's built to withstand it.
